{"claims":[{"claim_text":"America's national security is the first order of business with Russia.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The United States and Russia share critical common interests.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Both Russia and the United States confront the legacy of a dead ideological rivalry — thousands of nuclear weapons.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"In Russia, thousands of nuclear weapons may not be entirely secure.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The United States and Russia together face an emerging threat from rogue nations, nuclear theft, and accidental launch.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"For its own sake and the sake of the United States, Russia must stop encouraging the proliferation of weapons of mass destruction.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The development of a democratic and stable Russia is in the interest of the United States and all of Europe.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The battle for democracy in Russia must be won by Russians.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Attempts to remake Russia from the outside are misguided.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The current administration's efforts have only propped up corrupt elites.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The current administration's efforts have identified America with discredited factions and failed policies.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The current administration's efforts have encouraged anti-Americanism.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The United States should show its concern about Russia's future by focusing on the structures, spirit, and reality of democracy in Russia, embodied by the rule of law.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The United States will direct aid and attention to help the Russian people, not enriching the bank accounts of corrupt officials.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
